description: Plan a monorepo publish order from the dependency graph: a deterministic topological order and depth levels for all packages, or for a changed set plus everything that transitively depends on it, reporting the exact cycle when the graph cannot be ordered.

changed.description: Names of changed packages; when given, the plan covers exactly these plus everything that transitively depends on them (optional)

packages.description: Packages in the monorepo (at least one)

dependencies.description: Names of packages in the set that must publish before this one (optional, default [])

version.description: Package version (optional; carried, not used for ordering)

name: plan_publish_order
